questions.question: Explain why (2/3)² = 4/9 and why the answer is smaller than 2/3.
questions.expected_answer: Squaring multiplies the fraction by itself: 2 × 2 over 3 × 3 gives 4/9. Two thirds of two thirds is a part of a part, so it is smaller than two thirds.

questions.question: Why is (1 1/2)² not equal to 1 1/4, and what is it?
questions.expected_answer: A mixed number must be converted first: one and a half is the improper fraction 3/2, and (3/2)² = 9/4, which is two and a quarter. Squaring the parts separately misses the cross terms.

questions.question: Find √(9/16) and ∛(8/27), stating the rule used.
questions.expected_answer: A root of a fraction is the root of the numerator over the root of the denominator: √(9/16) = 3/4 and ∛(8/27) = 2/3.
